new:
Within-family validation settings are Ridge alpha=1000, LASSO alpha=0.003, Elastic Net alpha=0.01 with l1_ratio=0.25, PCR K=5, and PLS K=1; OLS has no tuning parameter. The comparison selects PCR with five components. Test OOS $R^2$ values against zero are approximately −0.531% (OLS), −0.151% (Ridge), −0.136% (LASSO), −0.136% (Elastic Net), +0.024% (PCR), and +0.054% (PLS).

For CCB (0939.HK)
